summary: The PDF supports each part of the S1 assignment coding: the authors say they 'randomly assigned ideators to experimental groups' (PDF p. 13, Section 6.3) in 'a three-cell, between-subjects online experiment' (PDF p. 8, Section 4.1), where each ideator got a gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 usage scenario, a DALL-E 3 image, or, in the control, an instruction to imagine the idea with 'no AI support', and then rewrote their own idea, which is what gets scored. The caveats change no coded value: random assignment appears only once, in the limitations, with no method, allocation ratio, or arm sizes, and the sentence says 'experimental groups' without naming the control, although the paper's own 'experimental conditions' include it.
